issue.title: test_owner_switch_preserves_per_owner_drafts times out in Telemetry coverage-contexts, passes on other hosted runs
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-1s7.5 (note #11, 2026-11-11) and filed by the sase-1s7 land agent.

- FAIL: CI Telemetry run 42949481249, coverage-contexts job 130295013754, at master 1a5bb8097b. `wait_for` timed out after 60s; 60517 passed, 1 failed.
- PASS: coverage-contexts succeeded at 1df3ade04d on 42897324688 and 42933587314, and at b0f947b91d on 42966178009 (job 130348282153). That job ran for 1h20m. The test file is unchanged between these SHAs.
- Fail rate: 1 of 4 hosted coverage-contexts runs. It was not reproduced serially; no local run was attempted.
- The lane runs coverage contexts under xdist on a 2-CPU hosted runner, so the 60s semantic wait runs under heavy tracer overhead.
- Root cause is unknown. Lead: find which semantic state the owner-switch `wait_for` waits on, and whether the draft restore completes asynchronously after the owner switch under tracer load.
- Do not raise the 60s wait.
